title: Completion of a full input scan
statement: Let $M$ be a Turing machine with no work tapes, let $q$ be a state, and suppose that in state $q$ its transition on any input symbol and work-tape reading copies the scanned input bit to the output, moves the input head right, and remains in state $q$, while on a blank input symbol it emits nothing and halts. Then for every Boolean word $x$ and output word $o$, after $|x|+1$ steps from the scan configuration at position zero in state $q$ with output $o$, the machine is in the halted scan configuration at position $|x|$, with output $o$ followed by $x$.
hypotheses_covered: For every input and work-tape reading, the transition in state $q$ has the specified behavior
